result.title: Propose & Verify: Fast Reflection Symmetry Detection via Harmonic Fields
result.summary: Detecting multiple reflection symmetries in 3D shapes requires aggregating geometric evidence over a large space of candidate planes, making traditional voting approaches computationally expensive. We introduce the Fourier Accelerated Symmetry Transform (FAST), a training-free framework that combines geometric pair voting with efficient spectral computation. Exploiting the fact that global reflection planes pass through the shape centroid, we reduce the search to plane orientations, while geometric consistency filtering and independent witnesses suppress unreliable pair hypotheses. Our key insight is to represent these votes as a signal over plane orientations and efficiently compute a continuous, smoothed symmetry field in the spherical-harmonic domain. Specifically, we exploit the Funk-Hecke theorem, the spherical counterpart of the Fourier convolution theorem for rotationally symmetric kernels, to transform Gaussian smoothing into multiplication of harmonic coefficients. This enables efficient field evaluation, from which symmetry candidates are extracted, refined, and geometrically verified. Across two benchmarks, including a new benchmark of highly symmetric shapes, FAST achieves the highest clean multi-plane detection $F_1$ scores among evaluated methods (0.861 and 0.947), with GPU inference below 4 ms per shape: over $100\times$ faster than the next-fastest evaluated multi-plane GPU baseline. FAST also demonstrates strong robustness to geometric noise and competitive single-plane detection, achieving 94.9% success on clean single-plane shapes.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FAST：一种无需训练的 3D 形状多反射对称面检测框架，将几何配对投票表示为平面朝向信号，借助球谐域中的 Funk-Hecke 定理把高斯平滑化为系数乘法，从平滑对称场中提取候选并做几何验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 「提议—验证」结构与在连续假设空间上聚合证据、平滑打分再筛选的思路，可能为 LVR 中多 latent 假设的生成、证据累积与验证取舍提供概念类比，但属远领域线索，需核查其可迁移性。
